verdict.rationale: BugSnag's own CLI is documented as uploading files to improve the stacktraces in your errors (bugsnag-docs-45, bugsnag-probe-4), which is the core of symbol upload. The evidence never names dSYM, ProGuard/R8 mapping, or native (NDK) debug symbols, so mobile and native coverage is unproven. The JavaScript source-map support in bugsnag-docs-11 is a different story and is not credited. missing for 10: explicit documentation of dSYM upload for iOS, ProGuard/R8 mapping upload for Android, native/NDK symbol upload, evidence that symbolicated function names and line numbers appear, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
